## Acceptance criteria

List the observable conditions that must hold before a maintainer can consider the task complete.

## Contribution type

- [ ] Source analysis: submit a bounded finding and evidence only. It remains inert until human triage.
- [ ] Trusted local code change: a maintainer or trusted local contributor will create and test the change.

Pilot reviews provide technical feedback under the documented shared-ownership limits. They are not
independent verification, approval, or authority to merge. A human maintainer controls triage,
scope changes and merging.

## Evidence plan

List the smallest relevant checks or source references. Use synthetic, non-sensitive examples only.
